Cold witness now binds the saved full-run manifest source_closure_digest to the currently approved immutable source/build/harness closure.
verified_method_and_count_contract: Exact frozen inventory and model hashes; all 97 unique contacts and original slave/master references checked.
Three ordinary saved-feature groups only: 72 unchanged Slave:1, 24 FrontBearing Master:1, one CollectorFaying Slave:5; no response-guided reselection or reference/ownership swapping.

Each existing candidate sequence and deterministic lowest eligible ordinal remains bound to the reviewed native CAD/Common-face/frame/synthetic-ownership inventory. Current source resolver, face BRep identities, same point and original-slave frame are checked before fresh physical source access.

Public factory/refresh/getObservations used, one refresh and one observed native ownership context per group; every contact exactly once, 97 available pairs and 194 finite three-component sides required with nonempty original node/element provenance.
Every observed ownership node cohort, native assembly entity cohort and original reference is compared with the frozen contract; reported contributing node IDs must belong to that exact owner cohort.

All 48 unchanged bore pairs require ORIGINAL_NODE on both sides, distinct source identities retained by frozen/config evidence, exact original node and point IDs, and exact equality to this one freshly generated native FRD field.

Eight separate support controls retain original references, six Constraint modes, zero prescribed movement, exact native owned cohorts/minimum original node and original point; finite three-component raw fresh-U values are recorded separately without engineering thresholds or contact-slip classification.
verified_source_physical_and_custody_con: Only a new byte-verified private model copy and isolated stage profiles are used; original four retained model/sample/deck/request inputs are fenced before launch and in supervisor finally.

Imported old helper functions frozen/config read only their fixed byte-pinned original EVIDENCE paths; physical_snapshot uses only model/mesh identities and compare_deck uses its explicit arguments. Old helper approval, progress, reports, solver, saves and test methods are not invoked.

The old 955-path closure is required as a path set, freshly re-pinned together with current executable/Fem/native solver, source/built adapters, all seven files, method/inventory and actual separate review receipts. All bytes are archived and checked before launch and in supervisor finally.

Stage execution requires root-written stage-specific approval plus sampling/source/clean-build/harness review fields. Harnesses do not manufacture their own freeze; full/cold require the same closure digest as a successful no-U preflight.
No-U preflight has no writer, solve, refresh, save, recompute or response-read operation; selected current resolver calls and separate support identities are checked.

One ordinary native writer and bundled native solver only; unchanged model/mesh/configuration snapshots, solver hash, exact accounting request bytes and literal linewise physical deck equality are required. Only two declared nonphysical footer comments after END STEP may differ.

New solver directory and explicit new accounting result required. Only native runner-created BOUND source accepted; exact fresh FRD path/hash and generated deck/request/metadata/binary hashes fenced. No retained original FRD is decoded.

Physical snapshot/original copied file/source/generated-input/fresh-source fences remain in full witness finally; supervisor independently records original/source/build/harness fences and log/report/snapshot hashes on process exit or timeout.

Supervisor uses an isolated process group, 60-second phase progress, 180-second preflight, 3000-second full, 1800-second solver-phase, 300-second cold and bounded TERM/KILL/reap cleanup. Existing stage execution receipts and solver directories prevent silent reuse/retry.

Presolver working save is private setup, not a qualified result claim. Qualified successor save and passed report happen only after all 97/194, 48-pair and eight-support checks and fences succeed; any failure remains failure with last-phase evidence.
verified_saved_cold_chain: Actual saved FCStd XML literal/hash/accounting string properties are audited against the full-run manifest; no reconstruction of the literal observation JSON is substituted for serialized strings.

Manifest binds exact successor file hash, feature literals/hashes/selectors/contact names, analysis/mesh/solver/accounting identities, accounting literal hash, method/inventory/closure and fresh source/controls hashes.

Separate cold process opens only that private saved successor, requires all three features Historical and accounting Stale, exact links/selector values and all 97 contact identities/literal bytes/hashes preserved, and every qualified read rejected.

Cold does not refresh, write, solve, decode FRD, save, globally recompute or repair/remap IDs. Physical save/restore identity changes are reported rather than silently repaired; historical preservation is not source requalification.
Cold finally verifies unchanged private saved successor, fresh-bound-source hashes, original inputs and source/build/harness closure.
remaining_root_gates: Complete clean source/build/global quality gates and review the exact resulting compiled artifacts.
Root writes and reviews immutable stage approval freeze including this receipt and final source-integration review, with all required current source/build/harness pins.
Perform no-U preflight before separate full-stage authorization. Retain a failure without retry or tuning; run cold only after a genuinely successful full witness.
